reports.title: Celo Smart Contract Audit Report (CeloSuperchainConfig, 3rd audit)
reports.description: Third Hashlock manual security audit of the CeloSuperchainConfig.sol contract in celo-org/optimism, which implements Celo's two-tier (local plus upstream SuperchainConfig) pause mechanism. Covers the initial audited commit and a fix-review commit; only one Gas and one QA finding were reported, both resolved.

reports.report_file: Hashlock - Celo Optimism and Superchain (2nd Audit).md
reports.title: Celo Smart Contract Audit Report (Optimism and Superchain, 2nd audit)
reports.description: Second Hashlock review of Celo's custom-gas-token (CGT) modifications to the OP Stack contracts in celo-org/optimism, covering the Celo diffs against op-deployer/v0.4.7 (celo-contracts/v4.1.0, commit 2c50c87) and op-deployer/v0.5.2 (celo-contracts/v5.0.0, commit c138180) across L1 portal/bridge/messenger/SystemConfig/OPContractsManager contracts, L2 bridge/messenger/L1Block/ETHLiquidity/WETH contracts, and related interfaces and libraries. One Medium (ETHLockbox misaccounting in OptimismPortal2 with CGT withdrawals, resolved), four QA and one gas finding were reported; no High/Critical findings.

reports.title: NM-0579 Celo Contracts 13 Security Review
reports.description: Nethermind security review of the changes in the Celo core-contracts/13 release relative to core-contracts/12, covering 21 Solidity files in the celo-monorepo (governance, election, validators, epoch management, CELO token and related interfaces). Fixes were verified at final commit 89fa8f26; no Critical/High/Medium findings were reported.

reports.report_file: Nethermind - NM-0561 Celo Custom Gas Token.md
reports.title: NM-0561 Celo Custom Gas Token Security Review
reports.description: Nethermind security review of the Celo fork of Optimism op-contracts v2.0.0 and v3.0.0, covering only the diffs that re-introduce the Custom Gas Token (CELO as native gas token) feature. The review found no issues of any severity.

reports.title: cLabs Celo L2 Security Assessment
reports.description: Trail of Bits reviewed cLabs' Celo L2 (an OP Stack fork) at celo-monorepo 89591e1 plus PR #11261, op-geth c6d7b55, and optimism 50977c3, covering token duality, alternative fee currencies, the release/core-contracts/11-to-12 smart contract diff with a comprehensive review of EpochManager and CeloUnreleasedTreasury, the L1-to-L2 data migration tooling, and alt-DA batcher support. The report found no High findings (2 Medium) and includes a December 2024 fix review of seven PRs resolving eight of ten issues.

reports.report_file: Immunefi - Celo Audit Competition Summary Report.md
reports.title: Celo Audit Competition Summary Report
reports.description: Summary of the Immunefi audit competition (13 Nov - 6 Dec 2024) on Celo's smart contracts (staking and multisig architecture, 5,253 nSLOC) plus selected celo-org/optimism Go tooling, which yielded 3 critical, 3 high, 1 low/medium and 1 insight reports. Only the top three reports are detailed, targeting LockedGold.sol and EpochManager.sol in celo-monorepo and check-derivation/main.go in celo-org/optimism.

reports.title: Security Review Report for Celo (Staked CELO pull requests)
reports.description: Hexens reviewed the smart contract changes introduced by several pull requests to the celo-org/staked-celo repository (accounting fixes and new pausability functionality), scoped at tree commit 32c0e187 of the repository. Fixes were verified at commit c3b7fef0; one High finding (double voting via inconsistent proposal expiration in Vote.sol) was identified and fixed.

reports.title: cLabs Equivalent Tokens Review (Security Assessment Summary Report)
reports.description: Trail of Bits reviewed the differential changes (PR diffs) of Core Contracts Release 11 in celo-monorepo, focusing on the SortedOracles equivalent-tokens upgrade and the new FeeCurrencyAdapter, plus smaller changes to GasPriceMinimum, Governance and LockedGold. A fix review of the remediation PRs was performed on February 21, 2024.

reports.title: Security Review Report for cLabs
reports.description: Hexens reviewed the cLabs celo-monorepo pull requests bundled for Contract Release 10 (issue #10375), chiefly the Governance/LockedGold vote-delegation changes, the Ultra Green Celo FeeHandler contracts and the GasPriceMinimum basefee update, plus a January 2026 review of the PR #11617 delegation fix. The audit reported 8 Critical and 2 High findings, all fixed or acknowledged and validated by Hexens.

reports.title: CELO Liquid Staking (staked-celo) Report
reports.description: Verilog Solutions reviewed nine pull requests (#72, #74, #75, #80, #82, #88, #93, #97, #120) to the celo-org/staked-celo liquid staking contracts, covering validator deprecation and health checks, governance voting for stCELO holders, storage compatibility, support for more than 10 validator groups, and default/specific group voting strategies. The engagement was a PR-diff review; no High or Medium findings were reported (one Low and five Informational, all resolved in PRs #119 and #122).

reports.title: Celo Monorepo Report (PR Audit #9798-#10159)
reports.description: Verilog Solutions reviewed 11 pull requests to the Celo core protocol contracts in celo-monorepo, covering governance voting changes, election voting for more than 10 groups, ReleaseGold withdrawals, CELO token burn, read-only Attestations, fee burning and proxy/deployer housekeeping. The audit is a diff-based review of the PR changes; no High findings were reported and the two Medium findings were resolved in follow-up PRs.

reports.title: Celo Contracts Audit - PR#9740
reports.description: Verilog Solutions audited the OdisPayments contract, its interface and proxy introduced in celo-monorepo PR #9740, which lets users pay cUSD for ODIS quota. The review found no High findings, one acknowledged Medium (locked funds) and one Informational issue resolved via a follow-up commit.

reports.title: Smart Contract Code Review and Security Analysis Report for CLABS (Celo Contracts Release 8 / ASv2)
reports.description: Hacken reviewed the Celo ASv2 federated attestation and escrow contracts (FederatedAttestations, Escrow) together with their common helper contracts in celo-monorepo packages/protocol, with an initial review at commit d3322f4 and a second review of fixes at commit c1bd057. One High finding (Escrow withdrawals after expiry) was reported and fixed; remaining issues were Medium/Low.

major_finding_ids: Users can withdraw payments after expiry

reports.report_file: OpenZeppelin - Celo Contracts Release 7 Part I.md
reports.title: Celo Contracts Audit (Release 7, Part I)
reports.description: OpenZeppelin reviewed all changes to production Solidity files in celo-monorepo PRs 9041, 8993 and 8334, covering the new cREAL (Brazilian Real) stable token contracts, validator payment delegation in Accounts/Validators, and Exchange initialization without a stable token address. No critical or high severity issues were found; one Medium issue was fixed in PR 9283.

reports.report_file: OpenZeppelin - Celo Contracts Release 7 Part II.md
reports.title: Celo Contracts Audit (Release 7, Part II)
reports.description: OpenZeppelin reviewed the production Solidity changes in celo-monorepo PRs #9252 (Exchange.setSpread bounds check), #9367 (Reserve.addToken oracle check removal) and #9369 (LockedGold.getPendingWithdrawal), which together with Part I form Celo's Release 7. Only Low and informational issues were found; fixes were verified in follow-up PRs.

reports.title: Smart Contract Assessment - Staked Celo - Phase 2
reports.description: Static analysis and manual review of the Staked Celo smart contracts (contracts directory) on master plus two unmerged branches (rebasing wrapper token and voting limit), delivered April 21, 2022. A reassessment of master after the branches were merged was delivered May 4, 2022 and re-checked the status of the original findings.

reports.title: Celo Contracts Audit – Release 6
reports.description: Diff audit by OpenZeppelin of the changes in pull requests #8300, #8349, #8360, #8475, #8750, #8751, #8831 and #8854 to Celo's core protocol contracts and upgrade deployment scripts planned for Core Contracts Release 6. No critical or high severity issues were found; four low-severity findings were reported and fixed.

reports.title: Celo Contracts Audit Release 5
reports.description: Diff audit of the Celo core contract changes introduced in celo-monorepo pull requests #8129 (GrandaMento stability mechanism and supporting Reserve/StableToken/Registry changes), #7837 (UsingRegistryV2) and #8060 (Validators bugfix). Only production Solidity files within those PR diffs were in scope.

reports.title: Celo Contracts Audit – Release 4
reports.description: OpenZeppelin reviewed the diff of Celo core contracts between tags celo-core-contracts-v4.post-audit and celo-core-contracts-v5.pre-audit, covering generalized signer authorizations, InitializableV2, proxy clone factory, identity proxies, and cGLD-to-CELO renames. Fixes were verified at tag celo-core-contracts-v5.post-audit.

reports.report_file: OpenZeppelin - Celo Contracts Mainnet and Releases 1-3.md
reports.title: Celo Contracts Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin's multi-phase audit of the Celo core smart contracts in celo-monorepo/packages/protocol/contracts: a full review for mainnet (phases 1-2, Jan-Mar 2020) followed by diff audits of Releases 1-3 (2020-2021), including release/verification scripts in packages/protocol/scripts and lib. Node software, VM implementation, oracles, tests and mock contracts were out of scope.

reports.title: Formal Verification of Celo Governance Protocol
reports.description: Certora Prover formal verification of cLabs-provided invariants for Celo governance contracts (BondedDeposits/Accounts/LockedGold, Election, ReleaseGold, linked-list libraries) plus ERC20-spec checks of StableToken, integrated into CI across two phases. Three High-severity bugs were found and fixed before release; the report lists only the latest monitored commits per phase.

reports.title: Celo Oracle Client Security Review (Letter of Attestation)
reports.description: Letter of attestation for a July 2020 Trail of Bits review of the Celo Oracle Client, an offchain tool that fetches exchange price data and posts it to the Celo blockchain. Only the offchain oracle client software is in scope.

reports.report_file: irrelevant/NCC Group - Celo Security Assessment 2020 and Retest.md
reports.title: CELO Security Assessment 2020 & Retest (Executive Summary)
reports.description: Executive summary of an NCC Group assessment (January-February 2020, retest April 2020) of cLabs' offchain system that automatically trades on external exchanges to rebalance the Celo reserve, covering its database, Google Cloud Platform deployment, and application source code. No onchain protocol contracts are in scope.
